sloka: लक्ष्मणेन समुत्पाट्य एषा कण्ठे कृता तव ।सोभासे अपि अधिकम् वीर लतया कण्ठसक्तया ॥४-१४-९॥
transliteration: lakṣmaṇena samutpāṭya eṣā kaṇṭhe kṛtā tava ।sobhāse api adhikam vīra latayā kaṇṭhasaktayā ॥4-14-9॥

translations.english: 'O hero, you are shining with the creeper fastened to your neck , just as the fullmoon adorned with a cluster of stars shines in the sky.
